external_spec_note: Both the truncation mechanism (integer division on a small fees value) and the fee-accumulation intent (sell fees should increment tokensForLiquidity, mirroring the buy branch) are recoverable from this contract's own source; no protocol/business convention beyond it is needed.
case_notes: SafeMath's `.div()` (and `.mul()`/`.add()`) is load-bearing under Step 1 -- the relation's derivation depends specifically on `.div()` performing ordinary floor (truncating) integer division, which is exactly why `fees.mul(sellLiquidityFee).div(sellTotalFees)` collapses to 0 for small `fees`. Per Step 2 this is a generic, protocol-independent language/library-semantics fact (identical behavior in any contract that imports SafeMath), so it is recorded here as a case note rather than counted under Additional functions/Context breadth.
